answers.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear compliant with ANSI/IEEE C37.20.2 and arc-resistant per C37.20.7. The catalog entry for CROWN-ARMV describes arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear built to these standards, making it the appropriate choice.

The requirement pertains to testing and simulation of system operation, which is a general project requirement and not specific to a product. This is typically addressed by the bid manager or project team.
